Our LG Services in Bangalore

Is your LG RO leaking water, making unusual noise, or giving a bad taste? Don't worry!

We are Bangalore's leading independent LG Water Purifier repair service center. Whether you have an LG PuriCare, LG WW series, or any other model, our expert technicians can fix it on the spot. We understand that Bangalore's hard water damages RO membranes quickly, which is why we use 100% genuine spare parts to ensure your water is safe and sweet.

  • ✅Common LG Issues Fixed: Pump failure, SMPS burnout, continuous waste water, filter clogging, and motor vibration.
  • ✅Genuine LG Spares: We use original filters, membranes, and pumps with a 90-day warranty.
  • ✅60-Minute Arrival: Our technicians are located across Bangalore (Whitefield, HSR, Koramangala, etc.) to reach you fast.

LG Water Purifier Service FAQs

How much does LG RO service cost in Bangalore?▼

The basic visit and diagnosis charge is ₹299. This amount is completely waived off if you get your LG RO repaired by us. Spare parts are charged separately based on the issue.

Do you use genuine LG spare parts?▼

Yes, we only use 100% original LG filters, membranes, and pumps. All replaced parts come with a 90-day warranty.

My LG RO is out of warranty. Can you still repair it?▼

Absolutely! We are an independent service center. We provide out-of-warranty repairs for all LG models at very affordable rates.

How long does it take to repair an LG RO?▼

Most common issues (like leaks, pump failure, or filter changes) are fixed on the spot within 30-45 minutes.
